flavor.phonemic_palette: Akkadian backbone (sh, ', kh, ts, q; vowels a i u; endings -u/-tu/-um; mimation) with a Latinate overlay (a Romanizing legal/administrative register; -us/-or office-endings); theophoric on the Akkadian morphs (Tullaru-, Argantu-, Urlandu-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Roman + Mesopotamian per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Roman + Mesopotamian register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'sargonid'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Sargonid — cosmopolitan imperial bureaucracy of the scrubland; law, duty.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Sargonid (Roman + Mesopotamian) are a assertive imperial bureaucracy people seeded in scrubland, desert, plains. They prize law, duty, piety, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_infantry, archers, heavy_cavalry. Outsiders are met as cosmopolitan; their patrons touch law, war, trade.
